claims.exact_statement: Let g be any Boolean core on a uniform cube and let x be a fresh uniform selector bit. For arbitrary Boolean activations A_j on mutually disjoint fresh private blocks Z_j, arbitrary vectors v_j and orientations s_j, define F(x,z,y)=g(y+sum_j v_j 1{x=s_j} A_j(z_j)), h_j=(-1)^A_j, rho_j=Pr[g(y)!=g(y+v_j)]. All branch squared core spectra coincide, so M_W=0 and I_data=I(g). Put I_priv=sum_j rho_j I(h_j)/2 and I_x=Inf_x(F). Then B_W=H(F)-H(g)<=sum_j rho_j H(h_j)/2+I_priv+(3/ln2)I_x, and B_x(F)<=3I_x. Thus module certificates H(h_j)<=C_act I(h_j) give B_W<=max(C_act+1,3/ln2)I_W and a certified core constant C_core transfers at max(C_core,C_act+1,3/ln2). For private point activations, B_W<=5I_W and the selector-first physical singleton tree has B_i<=3Inf_i at every queried selector node, zero localized boundary bill at threshold3, and terminal entropy H(g) and influence I(g). The exact raw boundary surplus is 2I(D_x F)-I_priv=2sum_T ghat(T)^2 |T|d_T, removed by conditional Boolean-phase payment. These conclusions are uniform over finite module count, dimensions and fresh nesting; arbitrary terminal core FEI and Boolean-phase admission outside the stated structure remain unproved.
hypotheses: Uniform physical cube, entropy in bits, Boolean signs
x and private selector blocks fresh from the data core; private blocks mutually disjoint
Translations modulo2; v_j may coincide or be dependent and s_j arbitrary
Module FEI certificates required for module-constant transfer; point modules have inherited constant4
Full entropy closure requires a separate core certificate; terminal entropy is retained
Dirichlet I(D) means real squared derivative energy, not edge disagreement of a trinary function
